description: OpenCompare quality gates. Each command is a single argv (no && || | ;). install/build kept separate. Coverage map for the four single-direction mirror sync behaviours: (1) mirror delete opt-in - deletions start unchecked and only an explicitly checked path is deleted, with the summary, the executable count and Apply reading the same predicate; gates `sync-real-gate` (src/sync-real-gate.test.ts) and `test` (src/renderer/src/views/directorySyncDialog.test.tsx). (2) idempotent dry-run - after a select-all deletion the next dry-run of the same direction lists copy, update and delete all empty, and a repeated round stays empty; gate `sync-real-gate` (src/sync-real-gate.test.ts). (3) mtime and relative structure preserved - every written target keeps the source whole-ms mtime at the same relative path, including CJK / spaces and deep nesting; gate `sync-real-gate` (src/sync-real-gate.test.ts). (4) link mtime alignment - same-target links that differ only in lstat mtime give a positive align count with a runnable Apply, and align to the source, while the dialog and the gate share canApplySyncPreview / syncPreviewAction; gates `sync-real-gate` (src/sync-real-gate.test.ts) and `test` (src/renderer/src/views/directorySyncDialog.test.tsx). Coverage map for the four template placement behaviours, on real external directories only: (5) conflict and overwrite default-unchecked - a conflict, an overwrite and a directory-occupied row start unchecked and only an explicit check writes, and a rescan of written slots reports them as already placed and keeps them unchecked; gate `template-default-unchecked` (src/template-gate-default-unchecked.test.ts). (6) counts and apply read one resolved plan - the executable / rejected partitions of `resolveTemplatePlan` union to exactly the checked set and the real write set equals the executable targets; gate `template-single-source` (src/template-gate-single-source.test.ts). (7) source sha256 and mtimeSec preserved - every written target re-reads to the source bytes and whole-second mtime, and hash / missing / mtime tampering is reported while sub-second drift is not; gate `template-sha-mtime` (src/template-gate-sha-mtime.test.ts). (8) cancel writes nothing - an abandoned preview and a pre-aborted signal leave the full output tree unchanged with no temporary file and no new directory; gate `template-cancel-zero-write` (src/template-gate-cancel-zero-write.test.ts). The full real-directory end-to-end proof (>=1000 template slots, >=1000 scattered sources, Chinese + space paths, four levels deep, dry-run -> explicit selection -> apply -> per-row re-check -> rescan, read-only refusal + retry, directory-occupied and parent-file write failure) is `template-e2e-real` (src/template-e2e-real-directory.test.ts). Coverage map for the two template safety gates: (9) case-only collision and exact-name priority - `matchTemplate` / `createTemplatePlan` / `verifyTemplateExtraction` / `matchTemplateSlots` agree that an exact spelling wins and a unique case-fold hit is matched, conflict or placed while several case variants stay ambiguous and are never placed; gate `template-case-collision` (src/template-gate-case-collision.test.ts). (10) relative path containment and path-escape refusal - one shared pure predicate refuses empty, absolute, drive, UNC and `..` paths in the plan, the resolver and the executor with zero writes; gate `template-path-contained` (src/template-gate-path-contained.test.ts). Coverage map for the two template move gates: (11) per-row action column and explicit move - every source-bearing dry-run row reads its action (copy by default, move only when an already-checked executable row is explicitly selected) from `resolveTemplatePlan`'s action map, and the counts, the executable set and the real write set all read that one object; gate `template-move-actions` (src/template-gate-move-actions.test.ts). (12) real-disk move write verify delete keeps the source - a move writes the target, re-reads the target sha256 and mtimeSec against the current source, deletes only the recorded source after all three checks pass, and keeps the source plus the target with no rollback when a check or the delete fails; gate `template-move-verify` (src/template-gate-move-verify.test.ts). Spike teardown coverage: `spike-process-tree-gate` (src/spike-process-tree-gate.test.ts) pins the Linux detached process group and `-pid` group kill, SIGTERM then SIGKILL escalation inside SPIKE_PROCESS_EXIT_BUDGET_MS, the released stdout/stderr pipes and removed data/exit listeners, the same reap on the window-booted and process-exited paths, a separate driver process exiting 0 within 15 s with both spike.json and spike-launch.log intact, and the bounded drain-aware CLI exit (SPIKE_EXIT_FLUSH_TIMEOUT_MS). Release acceptance driver coverage: `verify-release-gate` (src/verify-release-gate.test.ts) pins the single `scripts/verify-release.mjs` implementation - fail-closed A layer (missing / extra / skipped check, sha256 / byte / version mismatch, missing evidence, fixed 15-check registry over identity / mac / linux / windows / cancel-log / evidence), zero heap sampling and zero local 6.4 GiB fixture access in `--layer=ci`, the B layer 16 MiB retained-heap line, and the read-only `.github/workflows/post-release-verify.yml` trigger / permission / artifact shape. Normalization coverage: `diff-normalize` (src/core/text/normalize.test.ts plus the existing diff / merge suites) pins both switches defaulting to on, strict CRLF / LF / CR block reporting, the strict same-text-different-bytes signal, an ignored newline difference never resurrected as a byte difference, no-facts safety, and character / whitespace / case / line-order differences surviving all four switch combinations. Real-disk normalization evidence: `diff-normalize-real` (src/diff-normalize-real-gate.test.tsx) pins default-on zero differences, strict-off newline and encoding differences, re-enabled zero differences, and status raw values that ignore the switches, over six on-disk variants (UTF-8, UTF-8 BOM, UTF-16LE, GBK; LF / CRLF) in a thousand-line and a five-mebibyte group. Text dual-pane coverage: `code-pair-actions` (src/core/text/diff.test.ts plus src/renderer/src/views/CodeView.switches.test.tsx, src/renderer/src/workbench/comparisonSwitches.dom.test.tsx and src/renderer/src/workbench/directoryCompare.test.ts) pins the default-off whitespace switch whose count, row status, inline segments and ruler markers come from one comparison while panel text and status probes stay raw, the explicit reload that re-reads both paths and keeps scroll / switches / old results when a side is unreadable, and the symmetric swap that mirrors paths, bodies, probes and stats without writing or touching the parent directory comparison. History safety coverage map: `history-safety` (src/history-safety-gate.test.ts plus src/renderer/src/workbench/historySafety.dom.test.tsx and src/renderer/src/workbench/historyHome.dom.test.tsx) pins the history entry add, dedupe, single removal and trim, the explicit clear, the mixed-kind 20-record cap trimmed newest-first, bad path detection with the leftmost failing side, the switch serialization roundtrip, reopen argument parsing, the empty history list, reopening a directory, file pair or merge, the error row marker with single removal, the empty envelope after a remount or restart, and path privacy in console output.
